init.title: Calendar feed
init.description:
You can publish this address's collection dates as an iCal feed. Google Calendar, Outlook and Apple Calendar can then subscribe to it.

iCal Feed Address:
{feed_url}

Anyone with this address can see your collection dates. Other calendar apps can only use it if Home Assistant can be reached from the internet.

update_failed.title: Bin collection data could not be updated
update_failed.description:
The Northumberland bin collection website could not be reached or its content could not be parsed. The calendar will continue to show previously fetched data until the next successful update.

Error: {error}
